entities.summary: Andrew George McCabe is an American attorney who served as the Deputy Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) from February 2016 to March 2018 and as the acting Director of the FBI from May 9, 2017, to August 2, 2017. McCabe joined the FBI as a special agent in 1996 and served with the bureau's SWAT team. He became a supervisory special agent in 2003 and held management positions of increasing responsibility until he was appointed deputy director of the FBI in February 2016. McCabe became the acting Director of the FBI following James Comey's dismissal by then President Donald Trump, and served in that position until Trump's appointment of Christopher A.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Deputy Director of the FBI from February 2016 to March 2018, McCabe played a key role in investigating Russian interference in the 2016 US presidential election. His leadership during this period had significant regional impact on national security and politics.
